title: SDLC Work-Item-Local Reference v1
description: A reference to an addressable entity in a work-item artifact. The value has the form {WorkItemId}#{repository-relative-filename}#{entity-kind}/{entity-id}; the filename is resolved below the .docs/work-items/{WorkItemId}/ directory, so the reference has no associated task.
$comment: SdlcWorkItemLocalReference is scoped to the work-item directory itself rather than to a task payload. For example, WI-0002#work-item.json#work-item/WI-0002 identifies an entity in the work-item root document, while WI-0002#steps/WI-0002-00000000-system-design.yaml#result/R-001 identifies an entity in a task-shaped document stored below steps/. A root-level task-shaped document remains a work-item reference because its path is resolved from the work-item directory; documents under steps/, tree/, or tasks/ may be resolved as task references when the host applies task routing. JSON Schema validates only the reference shape; the host must verify that the work-item, file, and entity exist and that the file is within the selected work-item directory.
